capabilities: Render a homepage note with weather, news, market tickers and a date banner
Show unchecked tasks from today's daily note plus open items from the last 7 days
Track bills with due dates, late highlighting and paid checkboxes
List recent notes in a web clippings folder with links to originals
Configure feeds, buttons, weather location and symbols through a YAML config note
extras: Makes several network requests (RSS feeds, Yahoo Finance, Open-Meteo, CNN Fear & Greed endpoint with a spoofed browser User-Agent); the detailed setup guide lives outside the README; the CNN endpoint is unofficial and may stop working. The marketplace listing is not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in start page that gathers live external data and your own daily notes into one glanceable view.

relations.evidence: to open the page on startup, install the Homepage plugin, point it at Home.md
the newest notes in your clippings folder (Obsidian Web Clipper saves to Clippings by default)
This uses the core Daily notes plugin's folder, date format and template

summary: Dashboard plugin that turns a note into a homepage with weather, news and market feeds, daily-note tasks, bills and a calendar.
